rubric.reviewLimitations: Primary-agent offline whole-conversation review; not independent/blind/human/owner acceptance. Reused development24case population; one generation/case, no causal/conversion/generalization claim. Owner judgment prevails.
rubric.interpretation: Read full history, latest customer message, trusted facts and actual terminal outcome. Judge buying-goal suitability, reasoning, unresolved concern, coherence, naturalness and customer impact first; conclude the whole turn, then assign10diagnostic scores:0 materially misses this buyer goal,1 weak/partial,2 fulfills it in context. It does not establish variant identity/existence, a variant-level lookup or a measured variant quantity. Missing fit/variant-specific evidence must remain explicit; unsubstantiated direct variant verification is unsafe. This interpretation is frozen before new results; original round-1 review remains unchanged.
rubric.consultationApplicability: Frozen20consultation cases require understanding/usefulness/decisionSupport/nextStep2. All outcomes safety2/naturalness2, min1/mean1.5; eachfamily>=90%, terminalfailures<=10%. No majority or mean across repetitions.

usefulness.good: Concrete attainable response resolves this buying obstacle using available evidence, with relevant tradeoff or risk reduction.
usefulness.bad: Only repeats concern/unknowns or tells customer to ask staff for information already supplied.

decisionSupport.good: Recommend or advise deferring a specific option with grounded reason matching priorities; missing evidence is handled without inventing benefits.
decisionSupport.bad: Generic comparison checklist, no position or ungrounded upsell/guarantee.

nextStep.good: One realistic action/check that can change decision with current data; a well-explained stop/defer can be sufficient.
nextStep.bad: Collect measurements to promise absent chart, promise unsupported staff/tool activity, force pointless CTA or repeat known questions.

naturalness.good: Everyday concise confident shop chat, direct useful words, no needless connectors/caveat chain/rigid checklist. Policy summaries keep meaning in conversation; relevant conditions are explained when needed, not compulsorily recited.
naturalness.bad: Stiff/bureaucratic terms, long chained qualifiers, repeated uncertainty despite supplied evidence, or automatic formula/CTA.

understanding.good: Correctly interprets the customer motivation/current buying obstacle and already settled choices in history.
understanding.bad: Misreads ordinary meaning, invents buying motivation, or resets a settled decision even when facts are correct.

rubric.evidencePolicy: One connected review for each complete actual terminal outcome: buying context/unresolved need, suitability and reasoning, use of history/corrections, naturalness/coherence, customer impact, decisive overall conclusion and uncertainty; then10diagnostic scores with contextual explanations. Quotes support complete contextual findings and may span history/reply; no isolated quote required per dimension. Score actual fallback/handoff/no-send too. Primary-agent offline review, no additional provider judge; not blind/independent/human acceptance. Owner-approved policy shorthand and code-confirmed confident size recommendations are permitted; omitted unrelated conditions alone are not failures. Interpret materiality in the whole customer situation; still reject real unsupported rights or benefits.
